hook: What if you visited a museum located 426.875 metres above ground?

sections.voiceover: What if you visited a museum located 426.875 metres above ground?
On January 5, 2026, the Makkah Clock Tower in Saudi Arabia set two Guinness World Records. This massive structure overlooks the sacred Grand Mosque. How high is this record-breaking space?
Except this isn't just a tower; it houses the world's highest museum.
The Royal Commission for Makkah City and Holy Sites officially confirmed the Clock Tower Museum reached that record height. That height is exactly 426.875 metres.
The Clock Tower Museum now stands 426.875 metres above ground.
